Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the release date information for "Farber's Nerve". While the WebSurfer correctly identified that the earliest *verified* release date on the IMDb page was April 2011 (DVD), the Planner failed to recognize that the film's production year (2006) and the title's presence in the search results as a "Short 2006" film indicated an earlier release (likely a festival premiere or limited release) that occurred before the 2011 home video release. By relying solely on the "DVD" date as the "earliest verifiable release date" without considering the context of the film being a 2006 short, the Planner drew the wrong chronological conclusion, leading to the incorrect answer that "Ekam - Son Of Soil" was released first.
